acceptance_evidence.criterion: All prior migration evidence exists, is internally consistent, and has no fail-closed condition.
acceptance_evidence.evidence: Seven required prior artifacts exist. MIG-01 has no fail-closed reasons; MIG-02 seals are PASS; MIG-03 verification is PASS; MIG-04 and MIG-06 are GREEN with no blockers.

acceptance_evidence.criterion: Canonical root ownership and installed hashes match the approved migration map.
acceptance_evidence.evidence: AGENTS.md and README.md match approved SHA-256 values. All 255 installed entries match transfer hashes and modes; no mapped path is missing.

acceptance_evidence.criterion: Collision and generated-exclusion decisions are explicit and content-preserving.
acceptance_evidence.evidence: AGENTS.md, README.md, and .gitignore merge decisions are explicit. .DS_Store files are untracked and ignored. All declared generated and dependency paths are absent from the installed map.

acceptance_evidence.criterion: Destination readiness is recorded without claiming implementation completion.
acceptance_evidence.evidence: MIG-06 records 1211 backend tests passed and frontend READY_CONDITIONAL. It states that readiness does not claim PRD or DESIGN implementation completion.

acceptance_evidence.evidence: MIG-01 scope excludes all four. MIG-04 records no consumer rewiring. MIG-06 records no live service or source-consumer touch.

acceptance_evidence.criterion: migration-handoff.json is green only when every migration baseline criterion passes.
